not_covered: The attempt's ML code runs inside the processes that write attemptTheory.dat and judge.out. HOL4 trusts its own disk format (Thm.disk_thm makes a theorem of whatever a .dat file says) and an ML program can print anything. A DELIBERATE forgery from inside the build is stopped only by the identifier deny-list (a text filter, not a proof) and by reading every proved script. The fix is a proof that leaves the attempt's processes: the pinned tree has a draft proof-trace format and replayer (src/postkernel/prooftrace, pft-format.md "Draft"); replaying each proved attempt's trace in a clean process against the frozen base would close it. Not done.
Reads are not restricted (AUDIT-BLINDING.md): the blinding rule is checked on the agents' tool logs.
